payload.tension: The passage states truthful speech, anger, work, and forgiveness. Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another. And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
